bias.label: Leaning down below 3,930; bounce off one-year low

event: US PPI (October) today, Fri 13 Nov, likely 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Bounce in Asia
bullets.text: Kitco showed gold at 3,909.90-3,911.90 at 04:04 SAST, about 33 dollars up after Thursday's drop.

bullets.title: Thursday's big drop
bullets.text: Gold closed Thursday near 3,877, down 2.76%, after a one-year low near 3,852 (TradingKey).

bullets.title: Still a down week
bullets.text: Reuters copy says gold is down about 4.4% this week, so the bounce is small against the trend.

bullets.title: Yields above 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield climbed above 5.1% and the dollar strengthened, which weighs on gold (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 85% odds of a December quarter-point hike and about 14.5% for a half point.

bullets.title: Iran and oil risk
bullets.text: Trump said the US no longer needs an Iran deal and oil jumped, which may give gold some safe-haven support.

bullets.title: PPI is today
bullets.text: October PPI is expected at +0.4% m/m, and a hot number after Tuesday's hot CPI could push gold lower again.
